Consumer def-finite-holonomy-normal-model consumes: Definition/Statement prose: The **finite-holonomy normal model** of $(L,T,D,H)$ is the quotient $$\mathcal N:=\bigl(\widehat L\times D\bigr)\big/ H,\qquad h\cdot(\hat y,t):=(h\,\hat y,\,h\,t),$$ with the diagonal $H$-action given by the deck action on $\widehat L$ and the holonomy action on $D$, together with the foliation $\mathcal F_{\mathcal N}$ obtained from the product foliation of $\widehat L\times D$ by the slices $\widehat L\times\{t\}$, which the diagonal action permutes.
